import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import kit, encode
types=[
 {"name":"Bool","kind":"bool"},
 {"name":"I8","kind":"int","bits":8},
 {"name":"S","kind":"struct","fields":[["k","I8"],["v","I8"]]},
 {"name":"Rows","kind":"array","element":"S","size":3},
 {"name":"Grid","kind":"array","element":"I8s","size":2},
 {"name":"I8s","kind":"array","element":"I8","size":2},
 {"name":"Str","kind":"string","maxsize":4},
 {"name":"AliasRows","kind":"alias","target":"Rows"},
]
PARAMS=[["rows","AliasRows"],["grid","Grid"],["s","Str"],["n","I8"]]
def mod(name,req): return {"name":name,"params":PARAMS,"result":["r","Bool"],"requires":req}
P={"rows":[{"k":1,"v":2},{"k":3,"v":4},{"k":5,"v":6}],
   "grid":[[1,2],[3,4]],
   "s":[97,98,0,99], "n":7}
cases={
 "all-field":   (["all","row",["var","rows"],["lt",["field",["var","row"],"k"],["field",["var","row"],"v"]]], True),
 "all-field-f": (["all","row",["var","rows"],["gt",["field",["var","row"],"k"],["const","I8",2]]], False),
 "index-nested":(["eq",["index",["index",["var","grid"],1],0],["const","I8",3]], True),
 "index-struct":(["eq",["field",["index",["var","rows"],2],"k"],["const","I8",5]], True),
 "all-nested":  (["all","g",["var","grid"],["all","x",["var","g"],["le",["var","x"],["const","I8",4]]]], True),
 "all-shadow2": (["all","x",["var","grid"],["all","x",["var","x"],["lt",["var","x"],["const","I8",5]]]], True),
 "add-in-all":  (["all","row",["var","rows"],["eq",["add",["field",["var","row"],"k"],["const","I8",1]],["field",["var","row"],"v"]]], True),
 "sub-underflow":(["eq",["sub",["const","I8",0],["const","I8",1]],["const","I8",255]], True),
 "match-rec":   (["match",["var","s"],"ab"], True),
 "match-var-n": (["match",["var","s"],"[a-b]{0,2}"] if False else ["match",["var","s"],"[a-b][a-b]"], True),
 "not-all":     (["not",["all","row",["var","rows"],["eq",["field",["var","row"],"k"],["const","I8",1]]]], True),
 "eq-alias-const": (["eq",["var","rows"],["const","AliasRows",[{"k":1,"v":2},{"k":3,"v":4},{"k":5,"v":6}]]], True),
 "implies-all": (["implies",["gt",["var","n"],["const","I8",5]],["all","g",["var","grid"],["all","x",["var","g"],["gt",["var","x"],["const","I8",0]]]]], True),
 "or-short":    (["or",["eq",["var","n"],["const","I8",7]],["match",["var","s"],"zz"]], True),
}
